description: Four analogue oscillator voices sharing one tuning, mixed by profiles that the fader scans through

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of all four voices
Tunes all four voices finely around the setting of the COARSE knob
Sets the depth of frequency modulation applied to every voice
Sets the FM input to linear scaling on the left or exponential on the right, where a full attenuator gives roughly a volt per octave
Detunes that voice away from the frequency set by COARSE and FINE, for unison beating and chorusing
Attenuates and inverts the CTRL CV input before it sums with the fader's parameter
Scans the selected mix profile, or sets the intervallic offset or the global detune when the CTRL button has reassigned it

Cycles voice 1 through four sub modes: an ascending ramp at the fundamental, a descending ramp an octave down, a square an octave down, and a pulse an octave down with automatic pulse width modulation
Cycles through the seven mix profiles, which set how the four voices combine as the fader moves
Switches what the fader controls: unlit the mix profile scan, white the intervallic offset, amber the global detune

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of voice 1 at a volt per octave, and is normalled to the other three voices until they are patched
Sets the pitch of that voice at a volt per octave, breaking the normal from voice 1
Modulates the pulse width of voice 1 in the third and fourth sub modes
Frequency modulation of all four voices, scaled by the FM attenuator
Modulates the mix profile scan, the intervallic offset or the global detune, whichever the CTRL CV mapping points at, scaled by its attenuverter

outputs.text: The four voices mixed at the levels set by the current mix profile

menu: Mix Profile: Cascade Crossfade, VCA, Voice Arp, Voice Subtraction, Odds to Evens, Smart Pairs, Constant Root — picks which profile the mix fader scans through
CTRL CV Mapping: Mix Profile Scan, Intervallic Offset, Global Detune — sets what the CTRL input and the fader act on, the same choice the CTRL button cycles
Interval Offset Mode: Standard, Diatonic — picks which set of intervals the intervallic offset moves the four voices through
